summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2004-1 filed an 8-K regarding a preliminary remarketing memorandum for its Class A-6 Reset Rate Notes, furnished by Navient Solutions as administrator to qualified institutional buyers. The filing includes pool information tables as of May 31, 2026. This is a routine asset-backed securities remarketing disclosure, not a special situation event. No transaction terms, acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change is involved. The trust is reporting Other Events and exhibits as part of normal ABS operations.
